name: dau-examination-system
description: Hệ thống Tổ chức Thi trắc nghiệm — Đại học Kiến Trúc Đà Nẵng (DAU Examination System)

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BE,FE" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov:backend && npm run test:cov:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/dist backend/node_modules frontend/.next frontend/node_modules frontend/out
